Subject: SOC2/DPA walk-through: narrow-window brokerage & cross-team handover

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call last week. Per our conversation, CrestPoint asked for a focussed SOC2 + DPA walk-through and a brief pen-test scope review. We want to keep this compact (90 mins max) and make sure the right folks from your SecOps and our engineering/compliance teams can join.

A couple of constraints from our side: Marissa (Security Engagement lead) is available after 17:30 CET most days next week, and Olga (Controls SME) can also do an evening slot but only on Thu/Fri. So I'm trying to broker a single narrow window that minimizes cross-time fragmentation for your team.

Proposed options (all CET):
- Option A: Thu 26 Feb, 17:30–19:00 (90 min) — preferred (Marissa + Olga available)
- Option B: Wed 25 Feb, 18:00–19:30 (90 min) — backup
- Option C: Split: Thu 26 Feb, 17:30–18:15 (SOC2/DPA), Fri 27 Feb, 08:30–09:15 (pen-test scope) — if you need to separate topics

Agenda (tight):
- 0–10m: intros + objectives
- 10–40m: SOC2 scope & evidence handoff (controls matrix)
- 40–60m: DPA data flows & retention Qs
- 60–80m: Pen-test scope & entry points
- 80–90m: Next steps & action owners

If you share a preferred slot or a small set of attendee names from your side, I can send a calendar invite and attach the controls matrix + DPA diagram for pre-read.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Solutions Lead, Security Engagement
Redwood Inference
(Attachment placeholders: SOC2-Controls-Matrix.xlsx [xlsx, 220KB])
